_note:
This is the game's DEFAULT style — the CAMERA, the RENDERING and the PALETTE, and nothing else. It is prepended to every art prompt for this game: room passes (.github/art/room.py), character rows (.github/art/generate_row.py) and the 'Generate game asset' Action all read it.

IT DOES NOT DESCRIBE THE ROOM PIPELINE, AND MUST NOT. That lives in docs/ROOM_ART_STANDARD.md and in the pass prompts under .github/art/room_prompts/, which are the single copy of the recipe. This file used to restate it — back when a room was TWO layers — and it drifted: long after the standard became THREE passes, this file was still telling the generator that a floor plate is 'a complete floor and its surrounding architecture', and that any door 'MUST be on the back-right wall'. Because styled() puts this text IN FRONT of the pass prompt, the stale copy won: the lounge's pass-2 plate came back as planks in a painted brown vignette instead of on flat white, which keys to nothing and makes the whole frame walkable. If a rule about how rooms are built belongs anywhere, it belongs in the pass prompt — point at it from here, never copy it.

HISTORY of the style itself, in one day: (1) close-up cinematic-portrait camera used for rooms by mistake — looked like a photo backdrop with cutouts standing in front; (2) fixed the camera but kept painterly/vignette rendering — still murky, user said 'think Stardew Valley'; (3) went fully flat cel-shaded Stardew — user said that 'doesn't fit the bill' and pointed back at the inspiration images and the already-generated portraits as the real target: richly saturated, moody, warm-vs-cool lit, textured.
camera:
Top-down RPG interior room view: a clean, gently-angled overhead perspective, orthogonal walls, a clearly readable floor plane. NEVER an eye-level photograph, NEVER a close-up character-portrait crop.

The prompt that follows says WHAT is being drawn — a whole composed scene, a bare walkable surface, a sheet of props, or a character. Follow it exactly, including what it says about the background: this paragraph fixes the camera and nothing else.
style: Detailed 16-bit pixel art matching this game's own established look (see reference/the-game/inspo-*.png and the character portraits already generated, e.g. michael.png, kat.png) — NOT Stardew Valley's flat cel-shading. Rich, saturated color with real depth: warm light sources (lanterns, windows, candles) casting an actual warm glow against cooler ambient walls/shadow, visible texture on surfaces (brick coursing, wood grain, fabric folds), confident dark outlines. Still requires clean, sharply readable orthogonal architecture — walls meet the floor at a clear line, furniture silhouettes are unambiguous — richness of color/lighting must never come at the cost of the room reading as a coherent walkable space. For a CHARACTER SPRITE: same rich rendering technique and palette as the portrait busts, at a small full-body top-down scale, head-to-feet, clean readable silhouette from the overhead angle.
palette: Saturated, warm-vs-cool contrast — warm amber/gold light pooling against cooler blue, indigo, or wood-brown ambient tone, matching the inspiration images (e.g. inspo-08's warm doorway/window glow against cool blue brick walls). Not evenly lit throughout — real light sources create real pools of brighter warm light against a moodier surrounding tone, as long as the overall room still reads clearly (no area so dark the architecture becomes ambiguous).
background: For a PROP SHEET or a SPRITE SHEET: every item isolated on FLAT PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF), uniform, hard-edged, with a wide white band between items and a generous white margin — never transparency, which comes back as a beige wash. For a single CHARACTER SPRITE: isolated on a transparent background, no scene/ground/shadow drawn in. For anything else, the prompt says.
constraints: No text, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements, no borders/frames or vignette baked into the image. STRICTLY no people, characters or figures anywhere in a room or on a prop sheet — a stray figure standing in the scene is a confirmed failure mode. Architecture must be clean and orthogonal — walls meet the floor at a clear, readable line — and rich atmospheric lighting/colour is expected and desired, not a flaw. A character sprite must be full body head-to-feet, standing, facing the viewer — never a close-up bust crop — and isolated ONLY on plain transparent background with no scene, room, walls, furniture or floor drawn in. Any character wearing glasses must have clearly visible human eyes — pupils and eye whites — showing behind the lenses, never blank/hidden skin tone.
characterSpecRule: Every character drawn for this game has a spec under `characters.<id>`, and the spec is the single source of truth: `.github/art/generate_row.py` BUILDS the prompt from it and `.github/art/verify_sheet.py character` CHECKS finished sheets against it, so a detail written here cannot drift the way one typed into a prompt does. Generating art for a character with no spec is refused — write the spec first. Newsey is an adaptation, so every spec also carries its PROVENANCE, and that is not decoration: the art is regenerated from these specs, so anything invented here becomes canon. `plotQuote` is the verbatim text about that character from the owner's original plot (PR #30, comment 5344870145) — copied, never paraphrased. Every material carries `source`, and there are three: "plot" means the quote states it; "owner" means the owner decided it directly in conversation (Kat's cat-face avatar) — it is not in the text but carries the same authority as if it were; "design" means we chose it and it is open to change. Only "design" may be changed without asking. Audited against the verbatim plot on 2026-08-28; that pass found Eric's robe had drifted grey-green when the plot says gray twice, May's shredded robe had been drawn as a neat one, Rex had acquired Chuck's beard, John had aged from late thirties into an old man, and the Devil had lost the two words that describe him — cartoon, and little.

nella.name: Nella (Infinity avatar)
nella.species: Nella's magical avatar inside Infinity. Plot: "It looked like I had transformed into a demon of some sort" — still recognisably herself, with horns, glowing red eyes and fangs added. Human build; the horns, eyes and fangs are the only changes.
nella.plotQuote: It was still myself, but a pair of bright red horns were poking through my black hair. I still had my glasses, but my eyes were glowing red. I had fangs. It looked like I had transformed into a demon of some sort. I was wearing a dark red robe. On my wrist was a copper bracelet decorated in light blue gemstones. / "It is copper, to reflect your ranking and aquamarine to reflect your dominant playstyle."

horns.note: TWO short curved bright-red horns POKING THROUGH her black hair — plot: "a pair of bright red horns were poking through my black hair". They emerge from the hair, not from a bare forehead. Small: not antlers, not a crown.

hair.note: Very dark, thick, shoulder-length, slightly wild.

glasses.note: Round lenses. Hidden by her hair from directly behind, which is correct.

robe.note: Dark crimson robe falling to mid-calf, NO HOOD — a hooded robe is John’s silhouette in this game.

bracelet.note: Copper band set with aquamarine gems — her rank. Copper is the LOWEST rank; it must never read as gold.

eyes.note: GLOWING RED eyes — plot: "my eyes were glowing red". Not merely red-tinted; they give off light.

fangs.appears: front views, when her mouth is open
fangs.note: Plot: "I had fangs." Small, not a monster's tusks.

nella.proportions: About four heads tall, head roughly a quarter of total height; a teenager, not a child.
neverDraw: horns larger than her own head

nella_human.name: Nella (real world)
nella_human.species: the same girl OUTSIDE Infinity, before the transformation — an ordinary human woman in modern clothes. No magical features whatsoever. NOTE: the plot never describes what she wears in the real world; the clothes here are a design choice picked to echo her crimson robe, not a plot fact.
nella_human.plotQuote: (The plot never describes Nella out of game. Everything here is a design choice, chosen to echo her avatar.)

hair.note: Black, thick, shoulder-length — identical to her avatar’s. The transformation adds horns, glowing eyes and fangs and changes nothing else.

hoodie.note: Red zip-up hoodie — the everyday echo of the crimson robe.

nella_human.proportions: Identical build to her avatar — the same girl. About four heads tall.

kat.name: Kat
kat.species: Kat, in his Infinity AVATAR: a human man's body with a CAT'S HEAD. Everyone in the Lounge is wearing an avatar rather than their real face — Nella's own is a demon — and Kat's is a cat, which is where the name and the "almost purring" voice come from. Head: short-furred cat, upright triangular cat ears, a proper muzzle and nose, whiskers, slit-pupil cat eyes, a wide friendly cat grin. Body, hands and posture are an ordinary man's, dressed in the robe and hat below. Warm, theatrical, immediately disarming — a charming gentleman with a cat's head, NOT a feral or monstrous beast.
kat.plotQuote: a man I had never seen before who was wearing a black robe and a top hat. He had black hair, glasses, and a large smile. / said to me, almost purring. "They call me Kat." / NOTE: the CAT HEAD is the owner's design decision for his avatar, not a line in the plot. The plot describes the avatar as it reads to Nella (a man, a hat, black hair, a large smile) and hints at the rest with "almost purring" and the name itself.

head.note: A CAT'S HEAD on a man's shoulders — dark short fur, pale muzzle and chin, pink nose, whiskers, upright triangular ears. NOT a human face, NOT a cat mask over a human face, NOT a full cat body.

ears.note: Two upright triangular cat ears with pink inner fur, standing UP THROUGH or IN FRONT OF the top hat brim so both the ears and the hat read at once. They are never flattened, never hidden by the hat.

eyes.note: Golden cat eyes with vertical slit pupils, behind the glasses. Friendly and amused, never predatory.

tophat.note: A BLACK TOP HAT, tall and flat-topped, worn over/between the ears. It is half his silhouette — never a cap, never bare-headed.

glasses.note: Round spectacles, worn on the cat face.

robe.note: Long black robe over a dark suit, cut for a man's body.

hands.note: ORDINARY HUMAN HANDS — the avatar is a cat head on a man, so no paws and no claws.

bracelet.note: Gold band with emerald gems. Never diamond — diamond is the top rank and belongs to Timothy.

kat.proportions: An adult man, about four and a half heads tall including the hat. Human proportions throughout; only the head is a cat's, and it is a normal head's size — not oversized or chibi.
neverDraw: a full cat body, or a cat walking on four legs
a TAIL — the avatar is a cat head on a man, and a tail also widens the side stride frames enough to trip the cutter's CROPPED check
paws, claws or fur on the hands
a bare head, or a short brimmed cap instead of a top hat
ears flattened down or hidden under the hat
a snarl, fangs bared, or any predatory expression

may.name: May 2000
may.species: a human champion duellist and idol — "beautiful", pink-haired, and in the scene she is introduced in, furious and dishevelled. Fully human, and drawn in exactly the same flat cel-shaded pixel style as the rest of this cast — no softer rendering, no painterly shading, no anime gloss that would make her look imported from another game.
may.plotQuote: a beautiful pink-haired woman stumbled out of the portal. She was wearing a silver bracelet that was decorated in dark sapphire gems and her royal blue robe was ripped to shreds, barely hanging on her shoulders, revealing her black leather jacket, white collared shirt decorated in pearls, blue jeans, and stylish black boots. / "May 2000... my hero as a pink-haired gamer girl kicking some serious ass." / May scowled

hair.note: BRIGHT MAGENTA-PINK, shoulder length. Her single most identifying feature. NOTE FOR CUTTERS: this is the same colour family as the sheet's magenta gridlines — see WALK_SHEETS.md; cells are cut between the green gutters so the divider is never keyed by colour.

robe.note: A royal-blue robe of ordinary CLOTH that has been RIPPED TO SHREDS: torn straight down in ragged strips, frayed and uneven at the hem, hanging off one shoulder so the black leather jacket and the white shirt underneath show. It hangs CLOSE TO HER BODY like wrecked fabric — a coat that has lost a fight. It must NOT read as feathers, plumage, fronds, fur or wings, and must not billow out wider than her shoulders.

jacket.note: Black leather jacket under the robe.

shirt.note: White COLLARED shirt decorated in pearls, visible at the collar.

bracelet.note: SILVER band with DARK sapphire gems.

may.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.
neverDraw: feathers, plumes, fronds or anything that reads as a bird
wings, or a robe spread wider than her own shoulders
a neat, whole or untorn robe
antlers, horns, animal ears or any animal feature

timothy.name: Timothy
timothy.species: a calm, kindly human duellist who steps in to defuse May — the highest-ranked of the group. The plot gives him no age; draw him as an adult, not visibly old.
timothy.plotQuote: Said the second man. He was wearing a dark gray robe, and had blonde hair. He had on a bracelet that just looked like it was made of diamonds. / "Something doesn’t add up about him, Timothy," she said

bracelet.note: ALL DIAMOND — "a bracelet that just looked like it was made of diamonds", the top rank. Bright, colourless, unmistakably not gold or silver.

timothy.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.
neverDraw: a coloured gem in the bracelet

rex.name: Rex
rex.species: an adult human man, "scruffy in appearance" but explicitly NOT dishevelled — unkempt hair and unshaven stubble on an otherwise tidy man. He smirks rather than smiles.
rex.plotQuote: The second person was a man, scruffy in appearance with red hair, and dressed in a deep gold robe. He was wearing a copper bracelet decorated in amethysts. Nothing about his appearance seemed disheveled, unlike the woman. / the red-haired man smirked

hair.note: Untidy dark-red hair — the plot says "red hair".

robe.note: DEEP GOLD robe with a wide collar. Note the tension the plot is pointing at: a deep gold robe above a COPPER bracelet.

bracelet.note: COPPER band set with AMETHYSTS — the detail May is suspicious about. Copper with purple gems, never gold.

stubble.note: Unshaven red-brown STUBBLE, NOT a full beard — the plot calls him "scruffy in appearance" and, in the same breath, says "Nothing about his appearance seemed disheveled".

rex.proportions: An adult man, about four and a half heads tall.

diamond.name: Diamond
diamond.species: a confident adult human woman, the self-declared star of Kat's table.
diamond.plotQuote: a young woman with black hair and rainbow highlights who shoved her feminine, manicured hand towards me. / Diamond, tossing her hair back over her shoulder

hair.note: Long BLACK hair — she "toss[es] her hair back over her shoulder", so it is past shoulder length.

highlights.note: RAINBOW streaks through the black hair — her name detail. Not chroma-key spill; they are meant to be there.

diamond.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.

eric.name: Eric
eric.species: A cheerful YOUNG human man — plot: "A young man with broad shoulders, blonde hair, and a gray robe", whose "laugh was comforting and warm".
eric.plotQuote: A young man with broad shoulders, blonde hair, and a gray robe, looked over at Diamond and started chuckling. His laugh was comforting and warm. / "I’m Eric," said the man in the gray robe.

robe.note: PLAIN GRAY robe over a plain shirt — a mid neutral grey, lighter than Timothy’s "dark gray". No green in it.

eric.proportions: A young adult, about four and a half heads tall, broad-shouldered.

magma.name: Magma
magma.species: A shapeshifter — plot: "a short and very young woman... barely older than a child", and as Nella shakes her hand "her face shifted, features becoming a bit older, hair becoming longer. It was like she was Mystique from the X-Men". Draw her YOUNG form; the shifting is a story beat, not a sprite.
magma.plotQuote: a short and very young woman sitting at the corner of the table. She was barely older than a child. [As] I reached out my hand to shake hers, her face shifted, features becoming a bit older, hair becoming longer. / "Princess, don’t go scaring the new girl!" ... Magma scowled

hair.note: Dark brown, SHORT bob — short so the shapeshift beat ("hair becoming longer") reads as a change.

coat.note: Rust-orange coat, the ember in her name.

magma.proportions: Young — slighter and shorter than the adults, about four heads tall.

john.name: John Boxley
john.species: the trapped creator of Puzzle Attack — a man in his LATE THIRTIES, not an old man: "handsome features" worn down by exhaustion, poor posture, back hunched, looking like he could fall asleep standing up, and mostly hidden inside a hooded robe.
john.plotQuote: In my doorway stood a man in his late 30s with short brown hair and dark eyes. He had poor posture and his back was hunched. He looked like he could fall asleep at any moment. He looked unkempt and his handsome features were hidden by his hooded robe. / "I am John. John Boxley."

robe.note: Heavy HOODED robe, hood always UP, falling to the floor — it is his whole silhouette.

hair.note: SHORT brown hair, barely visible under the hood.

skin.note: Only the face inside the hood, in shadow. NOTE: his robe hides his feet entirely, which is why the stance check cannot read him.

eyes.note: DARK eyes, deep-set — the plot returns twice to "his deep eyes" and "the intensity of his gaze".

john.proportions: A man in his late thirties, hunched — reads shorter than the others, about four heads tall. Hunched by exhaustion, not by age.

michael.name: Michael
michael.species: an adult human detective who runs a jazz coffee shop in the Library. Warm, watchful.
michael.plotQuote: an elegant looking man with a friendly smile and brown hair. / The gesture made his light blue robe fall off of his right shoulder... It looked like he was wearing a brown suit vest with gold buttons and a white undershirt. I caught a glimpse of something shiny... It looked like a badge.

robe.note: LIGHT-BLUE robe — his most identifying colour.

vest.note: Brown suit vest with GOLD BUTTONS over a white undershirt — plot's words, glimpsed when his robe slips off one shoulder.

badge.note: A badge glimpsed under the robe — Nella wonders if he is a police officer. It is deliberately hidden, so it is never drawn on a walk sheet.

michael.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.

kyran.name: Kyran
kyran.species: Infinity's head of research. Plot: "a man with dark hair and eyes who was wearing a lab coat and holding a tablet of some sort. He looked like a scientist", with a dazzling smile.
kyran.plotQuote: a man with dark hair and eyes who was wearing a lab coat and holding a tablet of some sort. He looked like a scientist. / The man smiled, and his smile was dazzling. / Kyran laughed, deep and warm.

labcoat.note: WHITE LAB COAT, open. His silhouette — never a robe.

shirt.note: Teal shirt under the open coat.

tablet.note: He carries a tablet in art of him at work; a walk sheet does not need it.

skin.note: Dark brown skin. This comes from the inspiration art (PLOT.md: "inspo: black scientist in the lab"), not from the plot text, which says only "dark hair and eyes" — recorded so nobody mistakes it for a licence to change him.

eyes.note: Dark eyes — plot: "a man with dark hair and eyes".

kyran.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.

chuck.name: Chuck
chuck.species: Nella's real-world best friend since high school; works at a lumberyard, drives a dark blue pickup. Plot: "He was a big guy, with dark curly hair and a large beard... Deep down, though, Chuck was a teddy bear." Imposing to a stranger, gentle in fact.
chuck.plotQuote: He was a big guy, with dark curly hair and a large beard. Deep down, though, Chuck was a teddy bear. / He pulled a brown paper bag out from under his red flannel jacket / I looked up into his deep blue eyes

hair.note: DARK CURLY hair — plot's words. Not straight, not light brown, and he is not bald.

beard.note: A LARGE BEARD, not a moustache. The shipped art gives him a walrus moustache and no beard; the plot says beard, and the plot wins.

flannel.note: RED FLANNEL JACKET — plot: "He pulled a brown paper bag out from under his red flannel jacket". The teal-blue hoodie in the current art is not from the plot.

eyes.note: Deep blue — plot: "I looked up into his deep blue eyes".

chuck.proportions: A big man in his thirties — broader and taller than Nella, about four and a half heads tall.

devil.name: The Devil
devil.species: the mirror-popup host of Infinity — plot: "A smiling CARTOON devil appeared in the mirror, as if it was a screen", and later "the LITTLE devil". He is not a character in the world: he is a friendly mascot drawn ON a screen, in a flatter, rounder, more cartoonish style than everyone else in the game, and he is small.
devil.plotQuote: A smiling cartoon devil appeared in the mirror, as if it was a screen. / The little devil pointed to the doorway and then vanished.

horns.note: Two small curved horns, rounded and cartoonish.

skin.note: Red skin — he is the only red-skinned character.

robe.note: Dark plum robe with crimson trim.

devil.proportions: SMALL and cartoonish — "the little devil". Roughly three heads tall with an oversized head, deliberately unlike the four-and-a-half-heads adults; he is a mascot on a screen, not a person in a room.
neverDraw: realistic proportions matching the other characters

adaptedFrom: The owner's original plot, posted verbatim as the FIRST comment on Clubhouse PR #30 (comment id 5344870145, branch clubhouse/the-game). `reference/the-game/PLOT.md` is a distillation of it and has lost detail that turned out to decide things — read the comment, not the distillation, before changing anything a spec sources to "plot".
